# BadBuilderLinux v2.3.0

Feature release adding **XeUnshackle Max** as a separate, optional bootstrap.

## Highlights

- Add XeUnshackle Max alongside the existing XeUnshackle and FreeMyXe bootstrap choices.
- Pin the official [klofi/XeUnshackle-Max v1.0.0](https://github.com/klofi/XeUnshackle-Max/releases/tag/v1.0.0) ZIP to its exact release tag, filename and upstream-published SHA-256.
- Install its `BadUpdatePayload` overlay and `launch.ini` using the existing safe preflight mechanism.
- Do **not** automatically copy the archive's JRPC2/Xbdm remote-access plugins onto the USB.
- Allow default homebrew auto-launch configuration using either XeUnshackle variant.
- Add regression tests for catalog pinning, bootstrap capabilities and installation-plan overlay behavior.
- Preserve the original XeUnshackle and FreeMyXe implementations, Linux disk safety checks, and Windows UAC handling.

## Features of XeUnshackle Max

XeUnshackle Max supports configurable auto-start, hiding CPU/DVD keys on-screen, boot-video customization and volume controls. It is still described by its developer as **beta** software.

Read the upstream usage notes before use. Do not flash a modified NAND or overwrite the console's flash boot animation. This USB builder erases the selected target disk.

## Downloads

- `BadBuilder-linux-x64` — self-contained Linux x64 binary
- `BadBuilder-win-x64.exe` — self-contained Windows x64 binary
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for both builds

Automated Linux and Windows tests do not replace physical Xbox 360 compatibility testing.
